title: C1 — Components, instances and styles
exercises: SYMBOL, INSTANCE, component properties, override tables, SharedStyleReference, styleId, publishedAssetGuids
record: which property was overridden on each instance
selection: every child of `C1 components`: the main components, the variant set, the instances and the three style nodes (not the frame itself)
notes: C1a main: TEXT component property "Label" (default "Fixture text") drives C1a label; children C1a label (TEXT) and C1a swatch (RECTANGLE).
C1b variants: property Size = Small (80 × 40) | Large (160 × 40).
C1c instance overrides: Label property → "Override text"; root fill → #FFF3BF; C1a swatch hidden.
C1d outer is a main component holding C1d inner (an instance of Size=Small); C1d nested is an instance of C1d outer whose inner instance is swapped (swapComponent) to Size=Large.
Styles: C1 paint style (solid #2F9E44) on C1e; C1 text style (Inter Bold 20) on C1f; C1 effect style (drop shadow 0,4 blur 8, 25 % black) on C1g.
provenance: Authored for the Penumbra Figma interchange tests by scripts/figma-fixtures in a scratch Figma file; synthetic content only. Built by Penumbra scripts/figma-curate.
